theorem_title: The concrete selected-color program decides its color witness
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumColor.program_meets {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {μ : ℕ→ℤ} {src n params row free k d : ℕ}
    (color : _root_.ThreeSum.Coloring.Parameter (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n+1)) (x : Fin n→ℤ)
    (hn : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ThreeSumWantedHostConditions.Ready k n) (hsrc : src+n≤free) (hparams : params+19≤free) (hrow : row+6≤free)
    (hok : (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.ThreeSumFastResourcesColor.need n (n^k)).Ok lim free d)
    (hread : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ src (List.ofFn x)) (hx : ∀ i, |x i|≤((n^k : ℕ) : ℤ))
    (hparameters : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ params (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightParameterInit.values n))
    (hcolor : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Seg μ row (_root_.ThreeSum.ColorParameters.fields color)) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightThreeSumColor.program 509 d [src,n,params,row,free] μ (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SharedTraversalCosts.colorBudget k n)
      (fun r ξ => (r=0 ∨ r=1) ∧ (r=1 ↔ _root_.ThreeSum.ColorClassLists.witness color x) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ξ free) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $x$ be a length-$n$ integer input with $|x_i|\le n^k$, and let a coloring parameter be stored in its six-cell row together with the exact nineteen-cell parameter initializer. Assume the readiness condition for $k,n$, the protected input/header layout, and the complete selected-color resource predicate. Procedure 509 of the fixed color program returns a Boolean exactly equivalent to the selected color-class witness, preserves memory below the free pointer, and runs within $\operatorname{colorBudget}(k,n)$.

This theorem closes the concrete selected-color decision by relating the executed guarded reporter to the original color witness.
